summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a leadership transition effective May 23, 2026, where Chairman Ms. Le Thi Thu Thuy ceased as Chairwoman and board member, succeeded by Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh. The filing states the change is to support global expansion. No financial terms, advisor, or shareholder vote are disclosed. The board now has six members, including two independent directors. The transition is a planned succession, not forced. The event itself is a management change, but the orderly process and ongoing advisory role of the outgoing chair keep the special-situation classification as a routine leadership transition; no risk-arb angle.
